Bulletin No: 04 MWA/26/08/17/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 17 August 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 18 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannarand from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts
extending from Kankasanthurai to
Kalpitiya via Mannar, and from
Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota
will be rough at times with strong
gusty winds up to (50-60) kmph.
The naval and fishing communities
are requested to be vigilant in this
regard.
